title: ゼルダの伝説 風のタクト
title_romaji: Zelda no Densetsu: Kaze no Takt
sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (an RVZ image, read with yomikata rvz offline): no reader's snapshots, no memory written
Characters are Shift-JIS; furigana taken from the message file in memory (zel_00.bmg), where each reading stands inline before its base
Played from power-on through the opening's legend and the sister on the lookout: what the script said agreed with the rows read off 32 of 32 pictures, over 2 scenes (3 are wanted: the bar isn't met)
The furigana are measured: a run played again with the readings kept, each screen's [base, reading] pairs read off its picture (compare with ruby): all 32 screens agree, every pair exact

Four sayings were left out of the comparison: two before the opening's first page (a buffer left from the name entry, said again once its page came), one with no window on screen, and one page said again at the start of the second run
notes: Read by the script games/gc/GZLJ01.lua: the page in the talk window or the opening's narration, with its furigana from the message file. Not looked at: who speaks, choices, menus, signs and item screens. The build is the disc's id and its version (docs/format.md).
